symptom: Enumeration values added without a caption (`create enumeration M.Color (Red)`, `alter enumeration M.Color add value Blue`) were stored with an empty caption: blank options in every drop-down, describe printed `Red ''`, and mx check reported 0 errors.
file: mdl/visitor/visitor_helpers.go buildEnumValues; mdl/visitor/visitor_enumeration.go ExitAlterEnumerationAction (add value). Test: mdl/visitor/enum_caption_default_2397_test.go
cause: The grammar makes the caption optional in both statements and the visitor defaulted an absent one to the empty string.
insight: **An optional property should default to what the authoring tool would fill, not to the zero value — especially when no checker flags the zero value.** mx check accepts an empty caption, so nothing downstream ever reported it. Distinguish 'omitted' (→ the name, as Studio Pro fills it) from an explicit '' (kept). Measured on 11.12.6: Red 'Red', Blue 'Blue', Green 'Green!' kept; mx check 0 errors.
